themes.description: Customers have reported receiving unsolicited calls from investment service companies, having their credit scores negatively impacted, experiencing difficulties with withdrawals, and being misled by marketing promotions. They also feel that their personal data is not being handled securely and are frustrated with the lack of support from the customer care team.
themes.business_impact: Customers are experiencing a high level of dissatisfaction and frustration with the app, leading to potential harm to their credit scores, financial losses, and damage to the company's reputation.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of these issues may be attributed to inadequate data protection measures, poor communication strategies, and insufficient training for customer support teams.
themes.action_plan:
• Improve data protection measures
• Enhance communication with customers about data sharing practices
• Provide clear and transparent information about marketing promotions and incentives
• Increase support staff training and increase responsiveness towards customer inquiries
• Revisit and revise data sharing agreements with third-party vendors.

themes.description: Users are unable to use their cashback rewards for bill payments and recharges, and are instead forced to use them for US stock purchases without their consent.
themes.business_impact: Loss of customer trust and revenue due to the inability to utilize cashback rewards, leading to increased churn and decreased customer satisfaction.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The recent update changed the cashback reward redemption policy without clear communication to users, causing confusion and frustration.
themes.action_plan: • Provide clear communication to users about the new redemption policy, offer alternative redemption options for bill payments and recharges, and ensure that users' existing cashback balances can be redeemed as previously intended. Review and revise the rewards program to ensure it aligns with user expectations and provides adequate value.

themes.description: Recent updates have caused several issues with the app, including cluttered interface, missing features, and broken functionality, which has led to frustration and disappointment among users.
themes.business_impact: High churn risk due to dissatisfied users and potential loss of revenue.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of these issues is likely due to aggressive feature updates or lack of thorough testing, which has disrupted the user experience.
themes.action_plan: • Conduct thorough quality assurance on upcoming updates, roll back recent updates to previous stable versions, and involve stakeholders in the testing process to prevent similar issues in the future.
